more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Gellan gum is used as a stabilizer in food. Its technological role is to help maintain the structure of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include other similar fruit or vegetable spreads, table-top sweeteners in liquid form, table-top sweeteners in powder form. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Produced by microbial fermentation of carbohydrates. The recovered polysaccharide is purified, dried and milled.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
A three-week human study and high-dose chronic animal studies reported no adverse effects.
